name: Condensation
desc: A fogged pane of glass drops in between the audience and the scene: droplets bead, swell until they break loose, run and carve clear trails that slowly fog over again, each bead lensing an inverted scrap of whatever is behind it with a hard little glint on its shoulder.

wetness.doc: droplet size + how thick the fog film sits

density.doc: how many droplets are on the pane

x.doc: the warm patch behind the glass, x

y.doc: the warm patch behind the glass, y

style.doc: condensation: warm-room fog, small beads, slow runs · rain_glass: a night car window — barely any fog, fat drops running fast in streaks · frost: the film freezes, beads become six-armed crystals that grow and sublimate · mercury: liquid-metal beads with chrome speculars on a dark film — no fog, no water

act.doc: bead: steady · clear: the pane is drying — the fog barely returns · steam: it keeps re-fogging faster than the drops can clear it

seed.doc: deterministic seed — same number, same piece
